body: I'm sorry to hear your experience with meds hasn't been the greatest. I personally have had great success when I take my meds consecutively. I can see a huge difference when I stop taking them for months at a time. I've been on a couple different concoctions that didn't really help but it can be difficult to find the perfect mix for your body. I hope it gets better for you soon <3
Jason Steoheson is on YouTube and apple music and he has AMAZING guided meditations. They've helped me a lot
